payload.title: Pilobol.us CMS build fails: Markus brand prerenders Next reader routes
payload.description: CMS Amplify app dv0pdx67fk80m builds fail since published articles exist in the backend: generateArticleStaticParams lists slugs from GraphQL, then app/articles/[slug]/page.tsx calls getSiteRenderer(), which throws MarkusSiteRendererError for Markus brands. Fix: Markus brands return [] from reader generateStaticParams and reader pages notFound().
